title: County funding for Lahaina Community Land Trust
summary: On April 21, a council member proposed a new $6 million grant to the Lahaina Community Land Trust to help homeowners facing gaps in rebuilding money. The member said the trust raised over $9.5 million using the County's first $6 million. Bill 4 would move $5 million from the Open Space Fund to a grant for the trust; testifiers said 25 parcels have been protected in just over two years.

A testifier said many lots may go up for sale once the fire settlement is signed, and the money helps keep them out of investor hands.
The land trust resolution passed with six ayes.
The vice chair said she will schedule the land trust to explain its funding at her committee.
The land trust representative said she will keep the council updated on any purchases.
The land trust has identified two, maybe three, properties that fit so far.
The land trust said some families who would still live on their Lahaina shoreline land, if not for the fire, face barriers to rebuilding.
Five million dollars in managed retreat funds was dedicated to the land trust by ordinance.
